title: Yellow Turmeric British Mushroom Cornish Pasty
description: A funky and juicy solo dinner dish featuring British mushrooms and unsweetened cocoa, wrapped in a flaky Cornish pasty crust, served in a scallop shell. This flexitarian-friendly dish combines the earthy flavors of mushrooms and turmeric with a hint of cocoa and nuka-pickle.

ingredients.name: mushrooms
ingredients.notes: British variety such as Shiitake or Button

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, sauté the mushrooms in a little bit of oil until they are tender and fragrant.
Add the turmeric powder, unsweetened cocoa powder, and nuka-pickle to the pan and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and cold unsalted butter to make the pastry dough.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the mushroom and cocoa mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the Cornish pasty in the scallop shell and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
